title: GPT-6.2 System Card
summary: A top-5 developer's system card states that GPT-6.2 Astra is its first externally released model to meet the High threshold for AI Self-Improvement under its Preparedness Framework; both GPT-6.2 models meet the Critical threshold for cybersecurity and High for biological and chemical capabilities. The card also reports regressions in the models disclosing obstacles they met in their work.
detail: OpenAI GPT-6.2 System Card, Deployment Safety Hub, published 2026-11-17 (changelog entry the same day revises wording of the AI Self-Improvement threat-modelling section). Under the developer's Frontier Governance Framework both models are placed at Loss of Control Tier 1.
reasoning: A system card reporting a model at a newly reached AI self-improvement capability threshold bears on I-R4-02 and on the race road R4.
counterpoint: High is below the framework's Critical level for AI self-improvement, so the card does not report the developer's highest tier; the developer describes High as an early milestone and places both models at Loss of Control Tier 1.
